test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A and B together can complete a certain work in 20 days, B and C together can complete it in 30 days and C and A together can complete it in 24 days. In how many days will A alone complete (7)/(12) part of the same work?
solution:
Given:

A and B together can complete a certain work in 20 days, B and C together can complete it in 30 days and C and A together can complete it in 24 days.

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency (Work done per hour) × Total time taken

Calculation:

LCM (20, 30, 24) = 120

Let the total work be the LCM of the time taken by different workers.

So, total work = 120 units

Let the efficiencies of A, B, and C be represented by A, B, and C.

According to the question,

A + B = 120/20

⇒ A + B = 6 ....(1)

B + C = 120/30

⇒ B + C = 4 ....(2)

A + C = 120/24

⇒ A + C = 5 ....(3)

(1) + (2) + (3),

2(A + B + C) = 6 + 4 + 5

⇒ A + B + C = 7.5 ....(4)

(4) - (2),

A + B + C - B - C = 7.5 - 4

⇒ A = 3.5

Now, A alone will complete (7)/(12) part of the same work in

⇒ ((7)/(12) × 120)/3.5

⇒ 20 days

**∴ A alone will complete (7)/(12) part of the same work in 20 days.**
